description: This file defines the SparkAsyncProfiler class, which wraps the AsyncProfiler for profiling Spark applications. It manages starting, stopping, and dumping profiling data, and handles writing output to HDFS or local storage.

classes.name: SparkAsyncProfiler
classes.description: A class that wraps AsyncProfiler to manage profiling tasks within Spark, including starting, stopping, and writing profiling data.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the profiler if it is not already running.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the profiler and finalizes data writing.

methods.name: requireProfilerBaseDirAsDirectory
methods.description: Ensures the specified DFS directory exists and is a directory.

methods.name: startWriting
methods.description: Initializes input streams and scheduling for writing profiler data.

methods.name: writeChunk
methods.description: Writes a chunk of profiler data to the output stream, handling pauses and resumes.

methods.name: finishWriting
methods.description: Finalizes writing, shuts down threads, and closes streams.
